name: NRI-Studio
description: Look Like VSCODE ( IDE Web Based)

paragraphs: NRI Studio is a full-stack, browser-based Integrated Development Environment (IDE) that closely mimics the behavior and UI of VSCode. Built for modern web development, it allows users to create, edit, save, and execute JavaScript and TypeScript code entirely in the cloud.
features: VSCode-like UI: Dark theme, collapsible sidebar, multi-tab support, and a dedicated status bar.
Monaco Editor Integration: Full IntelliSense, syntax highlighting, code auto-completion, and live error checking.
Single Workspace Explorer: Dedicated project view with "Open Editors" and "Project Files" accordions.
Local Folder Upload: Seamlessly import your local projects into the cloud workspace.
Live Terminal & Sandbox Execution: Run JS/TS code directly in the browser via a secure Node.js backend sandbox.
